$comment: Mixer strip tool presets (AU2 and AU3, plan 2026-11-18-audio-mixer-music). Data, not code: each preset is a full `filters` value (a preset with needs: mic gets duck.source = the microphone the user picks in the Tools window) for a project audio source (services/project/audio-filters.mjs ranges; validated by tests/audio-tools-routes.test.mjs). Offered in the Tools window, never applied on their own. Values are starting points for a voice mic, chosen from the libobs filter defaults and common streaming practice; not tuned on the user's mic yet (UNVERIFIED on a real stream).
source: Ujwalam AU2 (2026-11-18): libobs obs-filters 32.1.2 defaults (noise_gate_filter -26/-32 dB, compressor_filter 10:1 -18 dB 6/60 ms, limiter_filter -6 dB 60 ms) adjusted for a spoken voice

presets.name: Clean voice
presets.text: Takes out steady background noise, mutes the mic between words, evens out loud and quiet speech and stops peaks from clipping.

presets.name: Loud room
presets.text: For a noisy room or loud keyboard: stronger noise gate and compression, a little less low rumble.

presets.name: Duck music under my voice
presets.text: For music or game sound: it drops about 12 dB while you talk into your microphone and comes back about half a second after you stop.
